summary: Specifies an experimental variant of Internet mail that permits non-ASCII characters in email header fields, including in addresses and the information based on them. It is part of a set of experimental documents for fully internationalized email and updates the message format specifications. It was replaced by RFC 6532.

eli5.summary: For a long time email addresses only allowed basic English letters. This experimental plan lets the top part of a message use any language's letters. It has been replaced by RFC 6532.
